{{Top|leg}}
The '''advanced flame thrower''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] combat upgrade that had been designed to inflict a great deal of damage over a broad area. This weapon had been intended to be used by the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] and was not generally available to the public.

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 3 to be able to equip this item.
